statement: The range-equality supremum is the optimized complementary endpoint trace at the midrange.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {x : Fin n → ℝ}     {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (i j : Fin n)     (hlo : ∀ k, x i ≤ x k) (hhi : ∀ k, x k ≤ x j) (he : x j - x i = 2 * a) :     let c := (x i + x j) / 2     ∃ w ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, IsMaxOn (uniformTrace x a c) (Icc 0 1) w ∧       IsLUB ((fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ likelihood x a p.1 p.2) '' (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0))         (uniformTrace x a c w) ∧       ∀ m s : ℝ, 0 < s → likelihood x a m s < uniformTrace x a c w

statement: The exact trace maximum uses the fraction of lower endpoint observations among all endpoints.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {x : Fin n → ℝ}     {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (i j : Fin n)     (hlo : ∀ k, x i ≤ x k) (hhi : ∀ k, x k ≤ x j) (he : x j - x i = 2 * a) :     let z := (Finset.univ.filter (fun k ↦ x k = x i)).card     let o := (Finset.univ.filter (fun k ↦ x k = x j)).card     let w := (z : ℝ) / ((z : ℝ) + o)     let u := w^z * (1 - w)^o / (2 * a)^n     IsLUB ((fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ likelihood x a p.1 p.2) '' (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0)) u ∧       ∀ m s : ℝ, 0 < s → likelihood x a m s < u

statement: Constant observations at the held location yield unbounded likelihood as scale shrinks.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (m : ℝ) :     Tendsto (fun b ↦ inverseLogLik gumbelLoss (fun _ : Fin n ↦ m) (b, m * b)) atTop atTop

statement: A positive right-side deviation gives a unique free right-rate fit.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {L R a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hR : 0 < R) :     ∃! b, b ∈ Ioi (0 : ℝ) ∧ IsMaxOn (objective L R a) (Ioi 0) b

statement: At zero right-side deviation the strict supremum is the power face with left rate held.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {L a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :     Tendsto (objective L 0 a) atTop (𝓝 (log a - a * L)) ∧       IsLUB (objective L 0 a '' Ioi 0) (log a - a * L) ∧       ∀ b > 0, objective L 0 a b < log a - a * L

statement: A positive left-side deviation gives a unique free left-rate fit.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {L R b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) (hL : 0 < L) :     ∃! a, a ∈ Ioi (0 : ℝ) ∧ IsMaxOn (fun r ↦ objective L R r b) (Ioi 0) a

statement: At zero left-side deviation the strict supremum is the Pareto face with right rate held.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {R b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) :     Tendsto (fun a ↦ objective 0 R a b) atTop (𝓝 (log b - b * R)) ∧       IsLUB ((fun a ↦ objective 0 R a b) '' Ioi 0) (log b - b * R) ∧       ∀ a > 0, objective 0 R a b < log b - b * R

statement: On all zeros, probability one leaves size unidentified and an interior held probability gives size zero.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {p r : ℝ}     (hp : p ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hr : r ∈ Ici (0 : ℝ)) :     IsMaxOn (fun s ↦ zeroLikelihood n s p) (Ici 0) r ↔ r = 0 ∨ p = 1

statement: On all zeros, size zero leaves probability unidentified and a positive held size gives probability one.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {p r : ℝ}     (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hp : p ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1) :     IsMaxOn (zeroLikelihood n r) (Ioc 0 1) p ↔ r = 0 ∨ p = 1
